title: Now message someone real
drDigitalIntro:
You have sent messages, reacted, attached photos and run a video call in practice. Now do it for real.
• Open your messaging app and send one message to someone who will be pleased to hear from you.
• React to something they sent instead of typing a reply — press and hold, or double-tap, the message.
• Send them a photo from your own library.
• If they are up for it, start a video call and find the buttons for muting yourself and turning the camera off before you need them.
drDigitalSuccess: Knowing where the mute button is before the call starts is the whole trick.
drDigitalHint: Read along, then open your own messaging app.
